answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, unlocked only after continuous uptime. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the haven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the ocean of a task receipt, and the garden is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
